title: Convolution Operators on Weighted Hahn Spaces
summary: This paper studies the convolution operator on weighted Hahn sequence spaces. The boundedness and compactness of these operators, together with the multiplier algebras of the weighted Hahn space and its dual, are investigated. A complete characterization of the spectrum and fine spectrum is obtained, with illustrative examples. The introduction of the weighted framework leads to the emergence of new multiplier and spectral properties.
